note: Shared synonym seed for sportly_food_synonyms: free-text term → one Ciqual food. Every row is here because running data/food-matching/terms.fr.json through similarity alone (server/__tests__/postgresFoodMatching.test.ts, 'without synonyms') could not put the right food in front of the user: the term fell below the candidate gate, its ten ranked candidates did not contain it, or — once, "raisin" — an exact match on an English label resolved it to the wrong food. A term that lands in the ambiguous band with the right food among its candidates is not seeded — that is the resolver working. Applied by scripts/seed-food-synonyms.mjs after the Ciqual snapshot; the foreign key needs the Ciqual rows first.
